integrity: Analytic asymptotic statements proved with compact-uniform Taylor expansion and strict concavity; finite exact rational witness and standalone finite numerical checks. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed gamma, omega and dimensionless reset rate as inverse temperature approaches zero. Ideal bosonic Davies bath rates diverge in this limit; pure or mixed reset targets are temperature-independent; no preparation costs. Ground/coherent global optimality is asserted only at sufficiently high temperature, not for every finite temperature. The exact finite witness is a separate positive-temperature comparison. No independently established priority or audit.
title: A sharp coherence threshold for steady reset-assisted qubit thermometry
